D5/S3/Arith/ExponentExchange/PrefixNorma.name: D5.S3.Arith.ExponentExchange.PrefixNormalForm.exists_antitone_exponent_form
D5/S3/Arith/ExponentExchange/PrefixNorma.signature: theorem exists_antitone_exponent_form {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ m ≤ n ∧ m.primeFactors.card = n.primeFactors.card ∧ (∀ p q : ℕ, p.Prime → q.Prime → p < q → m.factorization q ≤ m.factorization p) ∧ (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n : ℝ) / n ≤ (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 m : ℝ) / m
